name: update-docs
description: Analyze any project's structure and build (or restructure, or gap-fill) an audience-split documentation tree — written from the code, stamped with checkable front-matter, and verified for broken links, one approval-gated section at a time. Stack-adaptive (mobile / web / backend / library / CLI / monorepo). Proposes the tree first and stops for your approval, then previews each step before doing it and hands each one back for you to verify.
